Customer.title: Customer
Customer.description: A customer entry in the owner's personal ledger.

name.description: Full name of the customer (1 to 100 characters).

phone.description: Optional phone number of the customer (up to 20 characters).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the customer was created (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the customer was last updated (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

LedgerTransaction.title: LedgerTransaction
LedgerTransaction.description: A credit or payment transaction recorded for a customer, stored in integer paise.

customerId.description: Document ID of the associated customer under the same user.

type.description: Transaction direction: CREDIT (you gave) or PAYMENT (you got).

amount.description: Positive monetary amount in minor currency units (paise).

note.description: Optional transaction description or memo (up to 300 characters).

transactionDate.description: Timestamp representing when the transaction occurred.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the record was created (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the record was last updated (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

/users/{userId}/customers/{customerId}.description: Customer records owned by an authenticated user.

/users/{userId}/transactions/{transactio.description: Credit and payment transactions owned by an authenticated user.
